Text.Text: This is Dac City Security. If you have a complaint about the lifts, the desk is behind you. If you can handle yourself in a fight, stay, because I have work.
Then you are paid in full. Do not go far. People who lose fifteen in a week do something stupid, so ask me what they did next. I also have warrants on two of them.
You are back, and the farm watch says the line cutting stopped two nights ago. Did you kill all fifteen Eco-Terrorists?

A cell that calls itself a reef defense league has been cutting kelp lines and dumping solvent on the farms that feed this city. They have camps in the Sharptooth Jungle and they hold the old facility on the Coral Isles. I need you to kill fifteen Eco-Terrorists in either place. Come back to me here when it is done and Security will pay you.
Good. Kill fifteen Eco-Terrorists in the Sharptooth Jungle or at the Coral Isles facility, then come back to me here in the Elite Hotel. I want them to stop feeling safe.
Ask a marine biologist about that. I am a security officer, and three farm hands are in the clinic with chemical burns. That is the part I deal with.
My officers are trained for hotel corridors and cargo disputes. If I send them into that jungle, I will be writing letters to their families. You, I can pay.
I still need fifteen Eco-Terrorists killed. They are camped in the Sharptooth Jungle and holding the facility on the Coral Isles. Come back to me when all fifteen are dead.
Here is your pay. The lab opened one canister, and the survey lead was right about the blight. Somebody over there knows what they are doing. Ask me who is running the cell when you are ready.
You are back, and the seals are intact. The survey lead may weep on you. Is that all five Coral Sample Canisters?

They jumped a city survey team and stole the living coral samples the team had cut all season. The survey lead says you can breed a blight in those canisters and put it back in the water. I need you to take five Coral Sample Canisters back from the Eco-Terrorists who carry them. Bring them to me here and Security will pay you.
Good. Recover five Coral Sample Canisters from the Eco-Terrorists and bring them to me here in the Elite Hotel. Not every one of them carries a canister, so keep at it.
They would blight the farm beds. Kill the kelp, blame the farmers, and the council shuts the farms down for them. It is clever, and I hate that it is clever.
They split the canisters among their ordinary members so no single raid recovers them all. Any Eco-Terrorist might carry one, but not all of them will, so keep hunting.
I still need five Coral Sample Canisters taken back from the Eco-Terrorists. Not every one of them carries one, so keep looking, and bring all five here to me.
That depends on what the cell does next. Finish killing the fifteen Eco-Terrorists I asked for first, then come and ask me again.
Then the farms plant on schedule, and the reef gets argued over in the council chamber. The city struck this Tidecaller's Pendant for you. We give one to people who turn a threat back from the water.
You are back, and what is left of the cell is scattering into the jungle. Did you kill the Eco-Terrorist Leader?

We do not have a name, only a description and a location. The leader runs the cell from the facility on the Coral Isles and never leaves it, and the blight was her idea. I need you to go into the Coral Isles facility and kill the Eco-Terrorist Leader. Come back to me here when it is done and the city will reward you.
Good. Kill the Eco-Terrorist Leader in the facility on the Coral Isles, then come back to me here in the Elite Hotel. I am short of people I trust, so do come back.
I would take an arrest, but she will not offer one. Everything we know says she will die in that facility before she walks out of it in binders.
It is an old research station the city built and abandoned when the funding ran out. It has sealed corridors, bad sight lines, and her best people around her. Do not go in tired.
I still need the Eco-Terrorist Leader killed. She is in the facility on the Coral Isles and she will not come out, so you have to go in. Come back when she is dead.
Then we go after the person who ordered them taken. Bring me the five Coral Sample Canisters first, and ask me again.
Then the warrant is closed and here is the bounty. Their field teams will be a lot clumsier from now on.
You are back, and the cell's field chatter is using Quarr's name in the past tense. Did you kill Sable Quarr?

I have a warrant for Sable Quarr, who runs the cell's field teams out of the north of the Sharptooth Jungle. Every cut line and every burned farm hand traces back to a team Quarr trained. I need you to go to the northern jungle camps and kill Sable Quarr. Come back to me here when it is done and I will pay the bounty.
Good. Kill Sable Quarr in the north of the Sharptooth Jungle, then come back to me here in the Elite Hotel. The warrant says alive if practical, and it will not be practical.
Quarr moves between the camps in the north of the Sharptooth Jungle and is not always out with the teams. If you sweep the north jungle and find nothing, sweep it again another day.
I still need Sable Quarr killed. Quarr works the camps in the north of the Sharptooth Jungle but is not always in the field, so keep sweeping. Come back when it is done.
Then the gear stops coming. Here is the bounty in full. That was the hard one, and I knew it when I offered it.
You are back, and no supply run reached the cell this week. Did you kill Kael Drox?

Kael Drox is their quartermaster and the nearest thing they have to a soldier. Drox is the reason a pack of reef zealots carries military gear, and works out of the Coral Isles facility. I need you to go to that facility and kill Kael Drox. Come back to me here when it is done and I will pay the bounty.
Good. Kill Kael Drox in the facility on the Coral Isles, then come back to me here in the Elite Hotel. Drox comes and goes with the supply runs, so you may need several visits.
It comes from another world, through somebody's back door. If I knew whose, I would be kicking that door in instead of talking to you.
Drox is the most dangerous of them, the leader included. Drox has done this before, somewhere else, for someone else, so go in prepared.
I still need Kael Drox killed. Drox works out of the facility on the Coral Isles but comes and goes, so keep checking. Come back to me when it is done.
Here is the patrol rate. The contract stays open as long as they keep recruiting, so come back whenever you want another sweep.
You are back from patrol. Did you finish the sweep and kill all twenty Eco-Terrorists?

Yes, it is a standing contract. I cannot spare officers for jungle patrols, so the city pays deputies by the sweep. For each sweep I need you to kill twenty Eco-Terrorists, in the Sharptooth Jungle or at the Coral Isles facility. Report back to me here when it is done and you draw the patrol rate, as often as you like.
Good. Kill twenty Eco-Terrorists in the Sharptooth Jungle or at the Coral Isles facility, then report back to me here in the Elite Hotel for the patrol rate.
The sweep is twenty Eco-Terrorists killed, in the jungle camps or at the Coral Isles facility. Report back to me when all twenty are dead.
I will leave you to it, Captain.
What other work is on your desk?
Yes, all fifteen are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. Fifteen Eco-Terrorists in the jungle or the facility.
Not right now. I stay out of politics.
Are they right about the farms harming the reef?
Why don't you raid them yourself?
What trouble is Security dealing with?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Eco-Terrorists.
Yes, all five canisters are back.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll get them back. Five Coral Sample Canisters.
Not right now. I am done with this cell.
Would they really blight their own reef?
Who is carrying the canisters?
What did the Eco-Terrorists do next?
Here are the five Coral Sample Canisters.
I am still recovering them.
Remind me what you need done about the stolen canisters.
What happens after I thin out the camps?
Yes, the Eco-Terrorist Leader is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll finish it. The Eco-Terrorist Leader in the Coral Isles facility.
Not right now. That is a step too far.
Can't you arrest her instead?
What is the facility like inside?
Who is running the Eco-Terrorist cell?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the cell's leader.
What happens after I recover the canisters?
Yes, Sable Quarr is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll serve the warrant. Sable Quarr in the north Sharptooth Jungle.
Not right now. Bounties are not for me.
How do I find Sable Quarr?
Do you have warrants on anyone in the cell?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about Sable Quarr.
Yes, Kael Drox is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring Drox down. Kael Drox in the Coral Isles facility.
Not right now. That is too much risk.
Where does their gear come from?
How dangerous is Kael Drox?
Who supplies the cell with its weapons?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about Kael Drox.
Yes, all twenty are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
Deputize me. Twenty Eco-Terrorists for the sweep.
Not right now, Captain.
Is Security hiring for patrol sweeps?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the patrol sweep needs.
